ranking_metric: Debian popcon installations (sourcemax/by_inst), maximum over binary packages of the source package
selection: Five control-verified C++ JSON packages rank by comparable Debian source-package sourcemax installations: JsonCpp 32,707, simdjson 2,688, nlohmann/json 1,799, RapidJSON 899, and Glaze 171. Boost.JSON 1.92.0 and POCO JSON 1.15.4 are verified but primary-unranked because their Debian sources cover the wider Boost and POCO suites. Their dev-package counts are separately labeled: libboost-json-dev 1,749 is JSON-specific; libpoco-dev 190 covers all POCO libraries and is not JSON-specific.
uncertainty: Seven C++ JSON package paths pass two valid controls with scoped parser source coverage and stable AFL++ feedback. Glaze uses a generic_i64 DOM and a parser-only probe; POCO JSON reaches its ParserImpl and bundled pdjson tokenizer with a parser-only probe. Glaze has 171 comparable Debian source-package installations, but the source metric favors runtime packages and undercounts header-only libraries. Boost.JSON and POCO have no JSON-specific Debian source count and remain primary-unranked; POCO's 190 libpoco-dev installs are suite-wide, while its component runtime 125 are all classified no_files. Three documentation leads remain unresolved: Qt, PicoJSON, and jsoncons. The 320 JSON-name source hits exclude Glaze, found by a supplementary exact source-name lookup. No complete top-ten claim follows. Two small valid controls do not establish complete RFC 8259, numeric boundaries, other encodings, or malformed-input behavior.
